gaps.description: The harvest directory (scratchpad/harvest/) contains only 7 of 11 module auditor reports: genus1.json, gl2tab.json, mfutils.json, polredabs.json are missing entirely, and gl2base.json holds only 3 of the 6 auditor fragments the owner says were merged (the fragments covering roughly lines 683-2011 and 2679-3300 are absent, i.e. the primary reports behind the owner's fixes at lines 806, 1204, 1482, 1589-1998, 2850, 2949, 2957, 3014 and the flagged items at 1767, 1998, 2922, 3178). For those ~40% of the package the disposition audit rests on owner self-reports. Mitigation: I read all four affected module diffs hunk-by-hunk and every hunk maps to a reported fix entry (and vice versa), and my spot checks of gl2base fixes from the missing-fragment range (GL2Triangular1Subgroup/GL2Borel1PC) verified clean. Within the 7 available harvest files, every single auditor finding (26 utils, 50 chars, 44 gl2base, 25 mfdims, 10 gl2points, 3 genus2euler, 6 tracehash) is dispositioned as fixed or flagged with repro — no orphans found. Two bookkeeping discrepancies only: tracehash owner says 'five findings' vs 6 in harvest, gl2points says '9' vs 10; in both cases all findings are in fact dispositioned.

Verified empirically: a failing assert (or any runtime error) halts a `magma -b file.m` run before later statements, so the 'ALL TESTS PASSED' sentinel is sound for assert failures — but a 'User error: Identifier ... has not been declared' does NOT halt the run; the enclosing statement (which can be an entire test loop containing hundreds of asserts) is silently skipped and the pass line still prints. I grepped all 11 current tests/logs/*.log for error strings and found none, so the current 11/11 green (re-confirmed by a fresh ./tests/run_tests.sh -j6 run) is genuine. But README's claim 'a crashed test can never pass' is overbroad, and a future typo'd intrinsic name in a test would pass silently. Recommend run_tests.sh additionally FAIL when the log matches /error/i.

Name-level coverage is essentially complete: 0 intrinsic names absent from tests for chars.m, genus1.m, genus2euler.m, gl2tab.m, mfdims.m, mfutils.m, polredabs.m, tracehash.m. Remaining never-invoked names: gl2base.m GL2NonsplitCartanFullNormalizer (its docstring was corrected in this audit yet the intrinsic itself is never called — tests compare against raw Normalizer(...) instead), GL2ScalarLabel (doc-fixed; the owner's claimed '8.2.1 vs 8.4.1' verification was not committed as a test assert), GL2SavePrimitiveSimilarityIndexes/GL2LoadPrimitiveSimilarityIndexes/SL2SavePrimitiveSimilarityIndexes/SL2LoadPrimitiveSimilarityIndexes (disk round-trip untested in the committed suite), GL2RefinementsOld (legacy); utils.m PrimeCount (needs the external primecount binary, acknowledged untestable offline) and PrintProfile (trivial); gl2points.m GL2PointCountPrecompute (exercised only indirectly via the plural GL2PointCountsPrecompute). utils.m IsRefinement is inside a comment block, a false positive of the scan.

Properly flagged with repros but still live for downstream users: (1) GL2MinimalConjugate returns non-minimal conjugates at composite levels (confirmed, validated fix exists, deliberately unfixed pending a decision on published RSZB/LMFDB label compatibility — highest-consequence open item since it is the label tiebreaker of last resort); (2) SlowTraceHash(CrvHyp)/TraceHash(CrvPln) crash on every input without the author's unshipped TracesOfFrobenius intrinsic, and the genus 2 fast path needs the external hashcurves binary; (3) polredabs/polredbest silently return the zero polynomial or [] when gp errors (e.g. non-squarefree input); (4) utils split(RngUPolElt,p) shells out to a hardcoded /home/drew Sage path; (5) the split/ReplaceCharacter/colsplit fixes assume Magma >= 2.29 Split:IncludeEmpty semantics — on an older Magma that dropped trailing empties the new code would be off by one (noted by two owners; a version-independent variant is sketched in their notes). All are documented in tests/README.md 'Known limitations' except the pre-2.29 portability caveat.

spot_checks.fix: genus1.m:515,525 PossiblyNonsurjectivePrimes(CrvEll[FldNum]) — replace nonexistent GL2FrobeniusMatrices(E,256) call with FrobeniusMatrices(E,256), and skip Frobenius elements with trace ≡ 0 mod l in the ell>=11 elimination loop
spot_checks.reasoning: Ran the fixed intrinsic myself: 232544.f1 (mod-11 image = nonsplit Cartan normalizer per LMFDB) base-changed to Q(sqrt5) now returns [11] via the previously-crashing default-A path (pre-fix code returned [] per owner instrumentation, silently violating the documented provable-containment guarantee); surjective control 37a1/Q(sqrt5) still returns [] (no wholesale over-retention) and 11a1/Q(sqrt5) returns [5]. Mathematically the guard is exactly Zywina's tr != 0 (mod l) requirement: trace-0 elements lie in the outer coset of BOTH Cartan normalizers and give u=0 (the projective involution present in every exceptional group), so KroneckerSymbol(t^2-4d,l) carries no containment information for them; since the guard only skips witnesses it can only enlarge the returned set, which the intrinsic's contract explicitly permits.

spot_checks.fix: mfdims.m:712 NewTrace via local newpopa1 — rewritten divisor sum: d restricted to primes with v_p(N)=1 and p^2|n, inner beta((n div d^2),(N div M) div d)*popa1(k,M,n div d^2) over M|N with GCD(M,d)=1
spot_checks.reasoning: Independent oracle sweep I ran from scratch: NewTrace(N,k,n) vs Trace(HeckeOperator(NewSubspace(CuspidalSubspace(ModularSymbols(N,k,1))),n)) for N in [1..20,24,27], k in {2,4,6}, n in [1..12] — 0 mismatches in 792 cases, including all the previously-corrupted classes (p||N with p^2|n, e.g. (6,4,4), (12,6,9), (18,4,9), (24,k,4), (27,4,9)) and the untouched gcd(N,n)=1 cases.

spot_checks.fix: gl2base.m:682,1818 GL2Triangular1Subgroup (Schreier transversal T[z]:=a, transpose reduction for Upper:=false, NegOne:=N le 2) + GL2Borel1PC (bottom-right-1 generators, unipotent exponent g[1][2]/g[1][1])
spot_checks.reasoning: Brute-force verification I wrote independently: for N in {3,4,5,6,8,9,12,15}, GL2Borel1PC(N)'s group equals the literal set {g in GL(2,Z/N) | g[2][1]=0, g[2][2]=1}, #P matches, and the returned map is injective on the whole group and multiplicative on 25 random pairs per N; GL2Triangular1Subgroup(H) equals {h in H | h[2][1]=0, h[2][2]=1} as a set (and the Upper:=false variant equals the transposed condition) for ambient/Borel/Borel1/two random subgroups at each N, with the input's Order attribute verified uncorrupted against pre-call enumeration and the result's NegOne attribute matching actual membership; the owner's specific pre-fix repro H=<[1,1,0,2]> mod 5 also verified.

spot_checks.fix: utils.m:862 NormalizedIgusaClebschInvariants GF(p) branch — reindexed from 5 Igusa slots to the 4 Igusa-Clebsch slots [I2,I4,I6,I10] with weights [1,2,3,5], 'return inv' -> 'return inv1' in the I6 branch, 4-vector in the all-but-I10-zero case
spot_checks.reasoning: My own exhaustive sweep over all separable quintics x^5+a3x^3+a2x^2+a1x+a0 over GF(5), GF(7), GF(13) (500+2058+26364 curves; p=7,13 exercise the p ≡ 1 mod 3 cube-root branch, p=13 was NOT in the owner's sweep): the output is always a 4-vector lying in the weight-[1,2,3,5] scaling orbit of IgusaClebschInvariants(C), and equals the output for the quadratic twist by a nonsquare on a ~1/7 subsample (4131 twist pairs) — i.e. canonical on twist classes; the Q branch on LMFDB curve 169.a.169.1 returns sane integral invariants [228,201,60501,574592]. Pre-fix the branch indexed inv[5] on a length-4 sequence, an unconditional crash.

spot_checks.fix: mfdims.m:937,971,1201 ALNewTraces repair chain — newszp restored to curried 3-arg form with skp(k,mm,GCD(n,mm)); skp's k=2 non-square-m/n squarefree/non-squarefree branch bodies swapped back; PrimesOnly:=false branch iterates all n coprime to N; plus FrickeNewTraces call fix at 1179
spot_checks.reasoning: Independent oracle I built: Trace(AtkinLehnerOperator(M,Q)*HeckeOperator(M,n)) on M := NewSubspace(CuspidalSubspace(ModularSymbols(N,k,1))). ALNewTraces (default PrimesOnly path, a guaranteed crash pre-fix) matches it elementwise for all 9 configurations (20,2,4),(24,2,8),(45,2,9),(48,2,16),(11,2,11),(36,2,4),(36,2,9),(27,4,27),(45,4,9) — including the k=2 non-squarefree-Q class the skp swap corrupted and the non-squarefree n=GCD(Q,mm) inner arms — and also matches ALNewTrace; the PrimesOnly:=false branch now returns one entry per n<=nmax coprime to N, matching the oracle; FrickeNewTraces(45,4,10) equals the Q=N oracle.

overall: This is a high-quality audit with unusually strong verification discipline: all five of my adversarial spot checks — chosen as the mathematically riskiest hunks (Zywina-style surjectivity elimination, two independent trace-formula repair chains in mfdims, the coordinated GL2Triangular1Subgroup/GL2Borel1PC rewrite, and the Igusa-Clebsch GF(p) reindexing) — verified CORRECT against oracles I built independently (ModularSymbols Hecke/Atkin-Lehner traces, brute-force group intersections, exhaustive curve sweeps over GF(5,7,13) including a prime the owner never tested, and live curve computations over Q(sqrt5)), with zero discrepancies across roughly 30,000 oracle comparisons. Disposition hygiene is clean where checkable: every finding in the 7 available harvest reports is fixed or flagged-with-repro, no orphans, and rejected lists are genuinely empty; the fresh 11/11 test-suite run reproduces the integration result in ~18s, run_tests.sh is executable and works as documented, and tests/README.md accurately describes the runner, conventions (all files do carry SetSeed), gitignore entries, and known limitations. Residual risks are modest and mostly documented: (1) the audit trail is incomplete — 4 of 11 module auditor reports plus roughly half the gl2base fragments are missing from harvest/, so ~40% of dispositions rest on (consistently diff-corroborated) owner self-reports; (2) the pass-sentinel methodology is robust to assert failures (verified: they halt magma -b) but not to undeclared-identifier errors, which skip statements silently — current logs are clean, but the runner should also fail on error strings; (3) a handful of doc-fixed intrinsics (GL2NonsplitCartanFullNormalizer, GL2ScalarLabel) and the similarity-index disk round-trips are never invoked by the committed tests; (4) the deliberate non-fixes with real consequences — GL2MinimalConjugate's non-minimal output (RSZB label tiebreaker), the tracehash external-dependency dead paths, polredabs's silent gp-error swallowing, and the Magma-pre-2.29 Split portability assumption baked into three fixes — are correctly flagged for maintainer decisions rather than papered over. Net: I found no incorrect fix, no undispositioned finding, and no false claim in the owner reports beyond two trivial finding-count slips; the package is in substantially better shape than before the audit, and the remaining exposure is concentrated in the explicitly flagged items, not in the applied changes.
